line.name: New Cuba Superior
line.description: Connecticut-wrapped, box-pressed premium expansion of Aganorsa's older 'New Cuba' brand. 'New Cuba' refers to a Cuban-seed tobacco varietal Aganorsa grows, used as the line's namesake/base filler. Launched at the 2023 PCA trade show.

research_notes: Not on the site at all. Note: the site's separate 'Connecticut' entry (Toro 6.5x52) appears to be a different, non-New-Cuba Aganorsa Connecticut product - do not conflate the two.
